notes: Bespoke PDP 'Section Product Information (Desktop)' at 1680px frame / 1440px container. Two-column layout: col-gallery (792px, vertical thumbnail strip of 5 + main image 654px with overlaid New/Featured badges and a '1 / 5 · vista frontal' caption) and col-info (528px). Library-instance heavy: blocks are named 'Block / X / Desktop' (Vendor, Reviews, Product Name, Price, Short Description, Variant Picker Color, Variant Picker Size, Stock, Add to Wishlist, Buy Buttons, Trust Bar) plus Atom components (Badge, Divider, Thumbnail, VariantSize, Quantity Selector, Icon/star/plus/minus/heart). Behavior hints: thumbnail gallery selector (Thumbnail Default/Selected states), variant swatches (image swatches w/ selected ring), size picker with Selected + Out-of-stock(opacity 0.4) states, quantity stepper (minus/value/plus), collapsible product accordions (4, all Closed/plus icon), 5-star reviews. Trust bar uses Merino/Base #faf7f2 bg. Sale price block has line-through compare-at + red sale badge. All names suffixed 'Desktop' — implies a separate Mobile variant exists elsewhere (mobile divergence likely). radius/button & radius/badge & radius/input all 0 (sharp corners). Single color mode observed (no multi-scheme).
